title: File Level Breakdown
html:
Explaining exact file roles, exported methods, dependencies, and security relevance inside secure E2EE chat modules.

Key System Files

File Path Core Exported Functions Dependencies Security Relevance
utils/crypto.js generateKeys(), deriveSharedKey(), encryptGCM(), decryptGCM() crypto-web-api / Node.js crypto Provides cryptographic primitives. Ensures standard AES-GCM and Curve25519 usage.
controllers/keyManager.js storePrivateKey(), getDecryptedPrivateKey(), rotateSessionKey() IndexedDB API, PBKDF2 utilities Handles secure storage and memory isolation of user key bundles.
server/socket.js initSocketServer(), verifySocketJWT(), handleConnections() socket.io, jsonwebtoken Authenticates inbound real-time channels and manages transport namespaces.
handlers/messageHandler.js onSendMessage(), persistPayload(), ackDelivery() models/Message, socketInstance Routes encrypted payloads to rooms and saves raw ciphertext metadata.
models/Message.js MessageSchema, indexes Mongoose ORM / Prisma Defines database constraints for ciphertext, IV, and authTag. Ensures no plaintext columns.
